entities.summary: Phil Lynott (b. 1949-08-20, West Bromwich) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in West Bromwich and Ireland. Known in the fields of ireland, composers & musicians, europe.
